S01.overview: We advise businesses on their structure, contracts and corporate responsibilities. Our work covers the legal arrangements needed to establish a business, manage relationships and carry out its operations. We help clients understand the obligations they take on and document decisions in terms that can be used in practice.

scope.title: Business formation
scope.text: Company and LLP formation, ownership arrangements and the legal structure for proposed business activities.

scope.title: Commercial contracts
scope.text: Supply, distribution, services, procurement, agency, franchise and other trading agreements.

scope.title: Corporate governance
scope.text: Board and shareholder processes, delegated authority, internal policies and governance documentation.

scope.title: Business reorganisations
scope.text: Internal reorganisations, transfers of business and coordination of corporate, employment and tax issues.

scope.title: Ongoing advisory
scope.text: Contract reviews, routine corporate questions and legal support under an agreed scope of work.

scope.title: Shareholder arrangements
scope.text: Rights, reserved matters, transfers, management participation and arrangements for resolving differences.

S02.overview: We advise buyers, sellers and business owners on acquisitions, disposals and combinations. The work begins with the structure of the proposed transaction and the issues that may affect it. We then support diligence, negotiation and completion, working with other advisers where financial, regulatory or overseas matters require their input.

scope.title: Transaction structuring
scope.text: Share purchases, business transfers, asset acquisitions, joint ventures and proposed combinations.

scope.title: Legal due diligence
scope.text: Review of corporate records, material agreements, licences, employment, property and identified legal liabilities.

scope.title: Definitive documents
scope.text: Purchase agreements, disclosure documents, shareholders agreements and supporting transaction instruments.

scope.title: Negotiation support
scope.text: Allocation of risk through warranties, indemnities, conditions, covenants and completion arrangements.

scope.title: Regulatory coordination
scope.text: Identification of relevant approval requirements and coordination with competition, tax and sector advisers.

scope.title: Completion and integration
scope.text: Closing checklists, transfer documents and legal work required for the agreed integration plan.

Our work covers the documents and processes governing the relationship, as well as issues arising during employment or on departure. Sensitive workplace concerns are handled with regard to confidentiality, fairness and the applicable legal requirements.

scope.text: Representation and advisory support in workplace claims, investigations and related proceedings.

S31.overview: We advise individuals on family and matrimonial matters with care for the personal circumstances involved. Our work includes explaining the legal options, preparing the necessary documents and representing clients in proceedings. Where appropriate, we also assist with negotiation and settlement, keeping the interests of children and confidentiality in view.

The work considers the assets, family circumstances and the client's intentions, together with relevant tax and cross-border issues. We also assist businesses in reviewing customer terms, complaint processes and product-related legal requirements.

Our work may involve interpreting a requirement, responding to an administrative action or pursuing an available remedy. Our work includes reviewing policy terms, assessing the positions of the parties and preparing the legal response to a dispute.
